column3: With respect to the BioMed MIT Portfolio Mortgage Loan (8.3%), the Appraised Value represents the “As-Portfolio” value of the BioMed MIT Portfolio Mortgaged Properties of $2.4 billion, which includes an approximate 3.0% portfolio premium, and results in a Mortgage Loan and Whole Loan Cut-off Date LTV and Maturity Date LTV of 35.3% and 55.2%, respectively. Based on the aggregate of the individual “As-Is” appraised values of the BioMed MIT Portfolio Mortgaged Properties of approximately $2.33 billion, the BioMed MIT Portfolio Whole Loan results in a Mortgage Loan and Whole Loan Cut-off Date LTV and Maturity Date LTV of 36.3% and 56.9%, respectively.
